Welcome to Your Home in the Jungle
Where the jungle whispers, and the soul rests.
Tucked away in the serene village of Taldem, surrounded by lush forests, gentle streams, and whispering trees, Jungletrails Homestay offers an authentic Goan escape for hardcore wildlifers, nature lovers, solo travelers, and families alike.

Here, you don't just stay you reconnect. With nature. With yourself. And with the slower rhythm of life.

Support the Community Every Contribution Counts
Community tourism thrives when people come together. It's about more than just travel it's about connection, culture, and creating lasting memories for the travelers and benefits for local people.
Whether you're a local looking to share your knowledge, a visitor seeking authentic experiences, or someone passionate about sustainable travel, this is the place for you here.
​
You can contribute in many ways:
Share your stories and experiences
Support local artisans and the women entrepreneurs
Volunteer your skills or time
Help spread the word about ethical, community-led tourism
​
Every action big or small helps strengthen local economies, preserve cultures, and protect the environment.
So however you choose to get involved, know this: you're part of something meaningful.

About Us | Jungletrails Homestay
top of page
About Us
​Welcome to Jungle Trails Homestay, a quiet retreat nestled deep in the forests of Taldem, a sleepy village in South Goa. We're not just another place to stay we're a family, a home, and a part of the land we live on.
Our Story
This homestay began as a simple idea: to share the peace and beauty of our village with those seeking something real. No neon signs, no party crowds just the sounds of the forest, home-cooked Goan food, and the warmth of village hospitality.
​
We the women of the Brahmani Self Help group have lived on this land for generations. We've grown up listening to the cicadas at dusk, watching the monsoon turn the hills lush green, and learning which herbs grow wild after the rains. We built Jungle Trails not as a business, but as a way to invite travellers into this way of life.
​
Located on the boundary of Bhagwan Mahaveer Wildlife Sanctuary and a few kms from the iconic 13th century Mahadev Temple of Tambdi-Surla, the homestay opens up immense possibilities to the travelers seeking to connect with mother nature.​
Why We Do This
We believe in slow mornings, sumptuous breakfast, good conversation, and the healing power of nature. We wanted to create a space where guests can unplug, unwind, and experience Goa beyond the beaches in its villages, forests, food, and people.
​
Hosting is personal to us. Whether you're here for a weekend or a week, you're not just a guest you're part of our home.
Sustainable, Simple, and Soulful
The homestay is a traditional mud house with cowdung smeared floor and blends naturally with the environment.
We compost, avoid plastic, and source ingredients locally from our farms and the forest.
We support local artisans and guides by weaving them into our guest experiences.
Come as a Guest, Leave as Family.Whether you're looking for a quiet retreat, a family getaway, a solo escape into nature, or a hardcore exploration of the wildlife, Jungle Trails Homestay offers a genuine connection to the land, to the community, and maybe even to yourself.We look forward to welcoming you to our little jungle paradise.
We are thankful for the financial and technical support provided by the Mineral Foundation of Goa to set-up the homestay and later the Goa State Rural Livelihood Mission (GSRLM) for supporting us since 2023. We are also thankful to our partner Mrugaya Xpeditions for the continued marketing and technical support
